name: P-800 Oniks (SS-N-26)
description: Supersonic anti-ship cruise missile — the round the Bastion-P coastal battery fires, and the reason a surface group can't sit comfortably inside 300 km of a defended shore. Ramjet-powered, cruises fast and low, then runs the terminal leg on the deck at ~Mach 2 where a defending ship has well under a minute of reaction time. Much harder for point defence than a subsonic Harpoon: the same CIWS burst gets a third of the engagement window. Visual stand-in: Storm Shadow body.
